landmarks.geometry: Same64 ordered landmarks/distances across every arm and all four ancestors in one seed block

memory.convention: Rows x@W; native Linear stores[out,in],usesF.linear; dimensions here[in,out]
memory.shared: Common seven maps/head for LM4 and T16. Ak(U),Av(U),Bq(U) reused once per bank; ordinary own mean-loss gradient,no detach/member surrogate.
memory.initialization: Aq,Ak,Av,Bq,Bk,Bv weights xavier_uniform_ in stated order with one isolated CPU generator; Wo exactly0,no random draw; E0; FS64 map r/s1
memory.slow_seed: s+491003041+1000003*b; non-I4b0; I4ownb; paired arms share six-map slow initial state
memory.memory_factorization: FS64/I4FS64 wrap all7 bias-free maps includingWo using exact FactorLinear M1. Retain initialized slow objects;unit r/s,member0. Candidate LM4 has no memory map factors.
memory.extra: No LayerNorm,FFN,extra heads,memory dropout,learned distance or attention temperature,row clipping,class memory,recurrence/state across updates,teacher or private native branch
memory.containment: Wo0 recovers native eval output exactly. First-step CE gradients to six maps/E are0; qualifier must inspect after readout becomes nonzero.

independent_ownership: I4S64/I4FS64: four disjoint complete source/head/maps/readout/offset/factor parameter sets,private Adam states/dropout RNGs and own selectors/stops/checkpoints. Serialize body fits,restore each own-selected body and serve original mean. No pooled or best-member selection,shared private state or teacher compression.

stage2_learning.fresh: Copy declared selected source head; fresh memory/optimizer/dropout streams for every arm/body; no selected arm-state reuse
stage2_learning.ties: Save initial checkpoint0; only strictly larger integer SELECT correct count replaces it. Earliest tied maximum retained; patience counts updates since best including0.
stage2_learning.optimizer: torch.optim.Adam betas(.9,.999),eps1e-8; explicit native lin3 slow/bias/r/s lr.005,WD.001; explicit every memory map,E and FS64 map r/s lr.0005,WD1e-8; never incidental parameter-name routing
stage2_learning.loss: Complete TRAIN11829 own CE only. All views at one incoming state; mean own CE backward; exactly one bank optimizer step after all views. No pooled CE,extra loss,label smoothing or refit.
stage2_learning.tail_dropout_seed: s+491003061+1000003*b+1009*v; isolated persistent native-device stream per body/view; non-I4b0,v0..3 as applicable; I4ownb,v0; eval consumes no draws
stage2_learning.selection: SELECT only; CAL/DEVELOPMENT never alter fits,geometry,roster,horizons or coefficients
stage2_learning.finite_checks: All logits/CE/live gradients/parameters/Adam finite; frozen source gradNone. Mismatch,nonfinite or cap fails exact record.

serving_and_CAL.raw: Original mean of class probabilities over actual four views/bodies; singles use native raw-logit argmax for selection; no weighted/router/logit mean
serving_and_CAL.temperature: One scalarT per complete endpoint:mean softmax(member_logprob/T),singles same law; no private member temperatures
serving_and_CAL.CAL: float64 CPU Adam lr.05,500updates,logTstart0,clamp[-5,5],latest tied minimum CAL NLL over states0..500
serving_and_CAL.export: Frozen raw member logprob/prediction custody; TEST labels inaccessible; DEVELOPMENT labels reader-only

gates.raw: On DEVELOPMENT:LM4 minus EACH reference >=.20pp mean over three paired blocks and strictly positive in EVERY block
gates.member: LM4 mean member accuracy minus mean separately selected equipped I4 BODY accuracy >=-.25pp mean,no block below-.50pp,separately against BOTH I4S64 and I4FS64 BODY means
gates.confidence: Temperature-calibrated DEVELOPMENT pooled NLL<=each reference+.005nat in EVERY block and LM4mean<=best reference mean. CAL suppliesT only; raw/confidence verdicts separate.
gates.failure: Any raw/member primary failure closes exact pilot,no rescue grid. Confidence failure retains unprotected confidence verdict.
gates.general_augmentation: S64/FS64 versus F1body0 and B1/B4 separately report general source-memory augmentation; cannot relabel LM4 failure
gates.diagnostics: Only after closure: full DEVELOPMENT repairs/harms,C=nodes with at least one correct member,L=covered nodes whose probability mean is wrong,A=nodes with no correct member whose mean is correct; served_correct=C-L+A and delta_correct=delta_C-delta_L+delta_A. Also retain no-correct counts,all member/macro/class/NLL metrics,new competent alternatives,strict common-false-rival cohorts. Whole population primary,no hard-cohort win substitution.
gates.interpretation: Three optimizer seeds on one encountered graph. No independent-node/seed generalization interval,unused confirmation,novelty,pure sharing/private-address/topology causality or superiority over complete original Graph Perceiver/MemGNN.

qualification.execution: Separate normal process beside Physics GRU; no host/device setting changes; root resource admission
qualification.source: Complete TRAIN update/forward/restore with all23 factors and source groups; no CAL/DEVELOPMENT
qualification.stage2: Each interface complete TRAIN update/forward/fresh restore. At least two updates for memory:step1Wo0 delays six-map/E gradients;step2must show finite nonzero CE gradients to every live memory map/E and FS64 map factor. Frozen source gradNone.
qualification.I4: Prove parameter/optimizer/RNG identity disjointness and own-selection serialization; measure full four-body serving construction/restore resources
qualification.containment: Checkpoint0 full TRAIN integer predictions/correct masks match source. Root freezes float engineering tolerances before qualification; not quality evidence.
qualification.closure: All declared trajectories and direct owners complete before opening DEVELOPMENT quality; retain every failure
